hypothesis: The ten unchanged NAND/NOR checkpoints propagate a learned consequence through one unobserved intermediate participant into a subsequent contact, retaining full-feedback competence without fitting or model expansion.

data.initial: All eight (a,b,c) anchors. Spectator bits and opaque identity permutations fixed before mode/law realization. Both persistent modes and global role reversals retained.
data.feedback: For every physical view include full and hidden twins. Both deliver full initial/first/final readings. Hidden delivers None for the structurally shared participant only after contact 2; sensor coverage remains all ids. Mask selection is independent of mode, law and bit values.
data.critical_selection: Evaluator only: replace the hidden participant in the true pre-final state with its last delivered value, apply the final contact, and select iff the physical final target differs. A different complete world alone does not count. Retain all other views as controls. No prediction-dependent selection.
data.information: The first complete feedback identifies the persistent mode for either law. All second/final oracle worlds are identifiable despite the masked intermediate; first forecasts have two equally likely worlds. Keep every action in the reported denominator; do not demand 95% pooled MAP correctness.
data.overlap: Audit exact blueprints and canonical topology/mask templates against actual NAND/NOR training and all historical banks. Constituents and two-contact prefixes are expected to overlap. The two cycle orders are isomorphic under identity/global reversal; old XOR cycle geometry is not new. The new evidence is withholding intermediate feedback under separately learned laws.
data.dependence: Law, mode, direction, condition, identity and model-seed views are dependent; report counts without treating them as independent physical trials.

checkpoints: Reuse the exact ten matched law checkpoints, five seeds per law. No crossed-law fits, warmup, calibration, optimization, checkpoint alteration or historical-study replay.
controls: Full-feedback twins use the same frozen checkpoint and physical trajectory. The stale-intermediate counterfactual is evaluator-only and diagnoses downstream consequence sensitivity; it is not a fitted baseline or evidence of architecture superiority.

analysis.criteria: Every law/seed/order/condition: complete support; >=95% identifiable exact worlds and identifiable role-pair conjunctions; zero unsupported MAP worlds and zero errors on known fixed unchanged values; mean joint oracle KL<=0.05 separately for identifiable and ambiguous points; ambiguous max TV<=0.1. Singleton oracle support plus zero unsupported MAP makes effective identifiable exactness 100%.
analysis.twins: Full/hidden distributions before masked feedback (steps 0 and 1) must agree within 1e-12. Every final twin remains in the denominator. Require no identifiable full-to-hidden regressions; record every repair/regression and NLL/probability difference, including adverse differences. No extra arbitrary probability-drop threshold.
analysis.critical: Every one of 48 critical hidden finals per law/seed must give the true singleton complete world >=0.9 and the counterfactual stale-target event <=0.1, summing over the entire joint distribution. Require complete matched full/hidden records. Do not condition forecasts on oracle support. Critical role-pair membership need not include both reversal directions.
analysis.probability_scope: Retain full joint soft tails, exact-zero truth probability as infinite NLL, abstentions and missing records. Planned denominators never shrink. MAP tie handling remains the existing lexicographic rule.
analysis.preservation_scope: Report realized unchanged-coordinate errors separately from known-fixed-value errors. Feedback withholding changes information, not checkpoint weights; paired changes are not historical parameter regressions.
analysis.limits: One hidden intermediate and one subsequent step under two separately learned laws, after full feedback identifies the mode. Not a fully open-loop rollout, simultaneous timing, a unified-law checkpoint, general calibration, independent custody or proof explicit world enumeration is necessary.

decision_order: STOP_INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION for incomplete collection, missing trace, failure or invalid artifact/binding
REVISE_HIDDEN_CYCLE if any frozen competence or propagation criterion fails
KEEP_HIDDEN_CYCLE otherwise; preserve all local differences and continue G2 without same-bank tuning
supplied: Stable entity handles, ordered contacts, exogenous readings and masks
Persistent-mode hypothesis and exact joint filtering/world enumeration
Evaluator physical law, independently coded truth-table oracle and stale-state counterfactual
Prospective cycle design, full-feedback twins and fixed probability criteria
learned: Previously fitted pairwise outcome likelihoods, role distinctions and unchanged-state behavior for each separate law
